name: line
description: Which line of the domain's trigram an axis is: 1, 2 or 3, line 1 at the bottom.

aiGuidance.purpose: Orders a domain's three axes so its leans read as a trigram.
aiGuidance.extraction: 1, 2 or 3. Follow the line order the owner fixed for the compass (srs-context cc05d4c9) unless told otherwise.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Not a rank or a weight. Two affirmed axes of one domain never share a line.
